jobs.title: Senior Director AI, Chief Revenue Organization
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

The Senior Director AI, Chief Revenue Organization leads the design, engineering, and deployment of generative AI and machine learning systems across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for building and scaling production-grade AI systems that directly drive revenue outcomes, including pipeline growth, deal acceleration, customer retention, and operational efficiency. This role will operate at the intersection of AI engineering, enterprise architecture, and go-to-market strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering leaders to translate AI capabilities into measurable business value.

Responsibilities

Lead End-to-End GenAI and ML System Delivery

Design and deploy generative AI and machine learning solutions embedded in CRM and customer workflows
Build systems including LLM-powered copilots, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and predictive models
Own the full lifecycle from data sourcing and model development to evaluation, deployment, and monitoring

Drive Hands-On ML Engineering Excellence

Architect and guide implementation of model training and fine-tuning pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face
Build real-time and batch inference systems, embedding pipelines, and vector database integrations
Establish best practices for CI/CD, experimentation, model evaluation, and observability across AI systems

Scale Agentic AI Systems

Design and deploy agent-based systems capable of multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and workflow orchestration across enterprise platforms
Establish reusable patterns for prompt management, tool integration, policy enforcement, and agent lifecycle management

Drive Revenue Impact Through AI

Partner with Sales and go-to-market leadership to embed AI into deal strategy and customer engagements
Contribute directly to pipeline growth, deal velocity, and account expansion
Translate AI capabilities into measurable outcomes including conversion improvement, productivity gains, and customer retention

Lead Cross-Functional Execution

Collaborate across Engineering, Data, Product, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver integrated AI solutions
Translate complex business problems into scalable technical architectures and ensure alignment across systems, data, and workflows

Build and Lead High-Performing Teams

Lead and grow teams of ML engineers, ML scientists, and AI architects
Establish a high bar for engineering quality, execution, and technical depth
Build scalable development practices and delivery models for enterprise AI

Qualifications

Knowledge and Experience

12–15+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or distributed systems engineering
8+ years leading ML or AI engineering teams in platform or infrastructure environments
Proven track record delivering production-grade AI systems at enterprise scale
Experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success organizations to drive business outcomes

Technical Expertise

Deep hands-on experience with generative AI including LLMs, prompt engineering, and finetuning
Strong experience with retrieval-augmented generation architectures and agentic AI systems
Proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern data stacks
Strong understanding of distributed systems, CI/CD, experimentation frameworks, and observability

Skills and Attributes

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen
Executive presence and influence
Structured problem solver
Systems thinker with enterprise perspective
Builder of teams and scalable operating models
Calm, decisive leader in complex environments
Experience with Salesforce or enterprise CRM ecosystems
Experience building internal AI platforms or developer tooling
Background in SaaS or enterprise software environments
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
15+ years experience
Bachelor's preferred

United States - Redwood City Office GHQ : 269,000 - 403,000 USD / Annual

United States - Dallas Infomart Office DAI : 224,000 - 336,000 USD / Annual

Canada - Toronto Office TRO : 182,000 - 272,000 CAD / Annual

Our pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for the full-time position determined by role, level, and location. The pay range shown is based on our compensation structure in place at the time of posting and may be updated periodically based on business needs.
Individual pay is based on additional factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and/or training.

The targeted pay range listed reflects the base pay only and does not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Employees are eligible for bonus, and equity may be offered depending on the position.

Equinix Benefits

As an employee, you become important to Equinix’s success. We ensure all your benefits are in line with our core values: competitive, inclusive, sustainable, connected and efficient. We keep them competitive within the current marketplace to ensure we’re providing you with the best package possible. So, wherever you are in your career and life, you’ll be able to enhance your experience and bring your whole self to work.

Employee Assistance Program
: An Employee Assistance program is available to all employees.

US Benefits: - Insurance: You may enroll in health, life, disability and voluntary plans that are designed for you and your eligible family members. - Retirement: You and Equinix may contribute to a retirement plan to help you plan for your financial future. - Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays: You will receive an accrued amount of PTO each pay period along with various paid holidays for you to rest and recharge. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific plan or program terms. Canada Core Benefits: - Insurance: You may enroll in healthcare coverage that is designed to complement the provincial healthcare system, along with life, disability and optional benefit plans that are designed for you and your eligible family members. - Retirement: You may also enroll in Equinix-sponsored retirement or savings plans: Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP), Group Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) and Tax-Free Savings Plan (TSFA). - Vacation and Paid Holidays: Equinix offers both vacation and personal time, along with various paid holidays for you to rest and recharge. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to specific plan or program terms, and to change at Equinix discretion.

jobs.description:

26WD101063,
Director, Product Management, Platform Trust

Position Overview

This role is accountable for defining what trusted capabilities Autodesk customers need and why they matter, partnering with product and platform organizations that determine how those capabilities are delivered. We are seeking an experienced Director of Product Management to lead the product strategy for Trusted experiences across Autodesk's platform ecosystem. Trust is foundational to every customer experience and every AI-powered workflow we deliver. This role will define the vision, strategy, and priorities for the trust capabilities customers expect and partner with product and platform teams to ensure these capabilities are delivered consistently across Autodesk products. Reporting to the Chief Trust Officer you will partner across Autodesk to influence platform investments and product strategy. You will translate evolving customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and competitive trends into platform investments that strengthen Autodesk's differentiation. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional leadership role requiring exceptional influence, strategic thinking, and execution across a global organization.

We are open to remote candidates based in the United States and Canada.

Responsibilities

Define the long-term product vision and strategy for Trust and Trusted AI capabilities across Autodesk's platform ecosystem
Partner with Platform Product Managers and Engineering leaders to prioritize customer-facing trust capabilities that can be leveraged consistently across Autodesk products
Develop business cases and product strategies informed by customer research, market trends, competitive analysis, technology innovation and evolving regulatory requirements
Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership on trust priorities and roadmap investments
Continuously evaluate the evolving security, privacy, resilience, and AI landscape to identify strategic opportunities and emerging customer needs
Represent Autodesk's Trust strategy with enterprise customers, strategic partners, and industry forums

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of Product Management or Platform Product Management experience, including defining platform strategy across multiple products
Experience influencing product strategy across large, matrixed organizations without direct ownership of engineering teams
Strong understanding of enterprise customer expectations around security, privacy, resilience, and AI trust
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive alignment across technical and business organizations
Strong ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, technical complexity, and regulatory considerations
Experience developing product strategies informed by customer insights, competitive analysis, and data
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business strategies
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with experience defining success metrics and measuring product outcomes
Experience presenting strategy to executive leadership and engaging directly with enterprise customers
Experience working effectively across globally distributed teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building platform products for enterprise SaaS or cloud platforms
Knowledge of modern security architectures, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, privacy engineering, or AI governance frameworks
Experience working with AI/ML platform capabilities and responsible AI practices
Familiarity with industry security and privacy standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, GDPR, CCPA, or similar frameworks
MBA or technical degree
Experience working with platform adoption, developer experience, or shared services organizations

26WD101063,
Directeur de la gestion des produits, Confiance dans la plateforme

Aperçu du poste

Le titulaire de ce poste est chargé de définir les fonctionnalités fiables dont les clients d'Autodesk ont besoin et d'expliquer leur importance, en collaboration avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes qui déterminent la manière dont ces fonctionnalités sont mises en œuvre. Nous recherchons un directeur de la gestion des produits expérimenté pour diriger la stratégie produit relative aux expériences de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk. La confiance est le fondement de chaque expérience client et de chaque flux de travail basé sur l’IA que nous proposons. Le titulaire de ce poste définira la vision, la stratégie et les priorités concernant les fonctionnalités de confiance attendues par les clients et travaillera en partenariat avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes afin de garantir que ces fonctionnalités soient mises en œuvre de manière cohérente dans l’ensemble des produits Autodesk. Sous la responsabilité du directeur de la confiance (Chief Trust Officer), vous travaillerez en collaboration avec l’ensemble d’Autodesk pour orienter les investissements dans les plateformes et la stratégie produit. Vous traduirez l’évolution des attentes des clients, des exigences réglementaires et des tendances concurrentielles en investissements dans les plateformes qui renforceront la différenciation d’Autodesk. Il s’agit d’un poste de direction hautement collaboratif et transversal, exigeant une influence exceptionnelle, une réflexion stratégique et une capacité d’exécution au sein d’une organisation mondiale.

Nous sommes ouverts aux candidatures à distance provenant des États-Unis et du Canada.

Responsabilités

Définir la vision et la stratégie produit à long terme pour les fonctionnalités de confiance et d’IA de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk
Collaborer avec les chefs de produit des plateformes et les responsables de l’ingénierie afin de hiérarchiser les fonctionnalités de confiance destinées aux clients, pouvant être exploitées de manière cohérente dans l’ensemble des produits Autodesk
Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des stratégies produit fondées sur les études clients, les tendances du marché, l’analyse de la concurrence, l’innovation technologique et l’évolution des exigences réglementaires
Assurer la coordination entre les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Sécurité, Confidentialité, Juridique, Conformité, Réussite client et la direction générale concernant les priorités en matière de confiance et les investissements dans la feuille de route
Évaluer en permanence l’évolution du paysage de la sécurité, de la confidentialité, de la résilience et de l’IA afin d’identifier les opportunités stratégiques et les besoins émergents des clients
Représenter la stratégie de confiance d’Autodesk auprès des clients professionnels, des partenaires stratégiques et des forums sectoriels

Qualifications Minimales

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produit ou en gestion de produit de plateforme, y compris la définition d’une stratégie de plateforme couvrant plusieurs produits
Expérience dans l’orientation de la stratégie produit au sein de grandes organisations matricielles sans responsabilité directe sur les équipes d’ingénierie
Solide compréhension des attentes des clients d’entreprise en matière de sécurité, de confidentialité, de résilience et de confiance dans l’IA
Capacité avérée à influencer les parties prenantes de la direction et à favoriser l’alignement entre les organisations techniques et commerciales
Grande capacité à concilier les besoins des clients, les priorités commerciales, la complexité technique et les considérations réglementaires
Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies produit fondées sur les insights clients, l’analyse concurrentielle et les données
Excellentes compétences en communication et en narration, avec la capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en stratégies commerciales convaincantes
Solides compétences en analyse et en réflexion stratégique, avec une expérience dans la définition d’indicateurs de réussite et la mesure des résultats des produits
Expérience dans la présentation de stratégies à la direction et dans l’interaction directe avec les clients professionnels
Expérience de travail efficace au sein d’équipes réparties à l’échelle mondiale

Qualifications Souhaitées

Expérience dans le développement de produits de plateforme pour des plateformes SaaS ou cloud d’entreprise
Connaissance des architectures de sécurité modernes, des infrastructures cloud, des systèmes d’identité, de l’ingénierie de la confidentialité ou des cadres de gouvernance de l’IA
Expérience de l’utilisation des fonctionnalités des plateformes d’IA/ML et des pratiques d’IA responsable
Connaissance des normes sectorielles en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité, telles que ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, RGPD, CCPA ou des cadres similaires
MBA ou diplôme technique
Expérience dans le domaine de l’adoption de plateformes, de l’expérience développeur ou au sein d’organisations de services partagés

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Benefits

From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting https://benefits.autodesk.com/

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $179,000 and $320,650. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

jobs.title: Director, GTM Planning & Compensation
jobs.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

Revenue Operations is a strategic growth engine at Clio, accountable for optimizing how we acquire, expand, and retain revenue globally. We partner with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Customer Support to design scalable GTM systems, align incentives to company strategy, and enable predictable, durable growth. The Revenue Operations team provides executive level insights, drives cross-functional decision making, and continuously improves GTM effectiveness through data, systems, and process excellence across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

We are seeking a Director of GTM Planning and Compensation
to own and evolve Clio’s global GTM planning, territory design, and incentive compensation functions as a core lever of growth, performance, and behavior change. This role is available to candidates in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto, or remotely across Canada (excluding Québec) and the US.

This role is responsible for translating company and GTM strategy into capacity plans, territories, quotas, and incentive design that drives the right outcomes across Sales, Channel, and Customer Success. You will operate as a strategic advisor to GTM and Finance leadership, balancing competitiveness, simplicity, scalability, and financial discipline.

You will lead capacity planning, territory design and maintenance, and incentive compensation planning, governance, and administration globally, oversee compensation systems and analytics, and build a high-performing sales planning function that scales with Clio’s rapid expansion. Your work will directly influence revenue predictability, seller behavior, retention, and long-term growth.

What you’ll work on:

GTM Planning, Capacity & Quotas

Leading GTM capacity planning and quota-setting, translating growth targets into coverage, headcount, and productivity plans across Sales and CS.
Developing and evolving quota-setting methodologies, ensuring targets are grounded in market opportunity, historical performance, and productivity expectations.
Partnering with Finance and GTM leadership to model capacity needs, ramp assumptions, productivity, and hiring requirements for annual and long-range planning, including scenario models that show the tradeoffs between headcount, coverage, quotas, productivity, compensation, and revenue before decisions are made.
Establishing planning frameworks and analytics to monitor capacity, quota attainment, and productivity and inform in-year adjustments.
Owning quota exceptions, relief policies, and disputes, balancing consistency with practical business judgment.

Compensation Strategy & Plan Design

Owning and evolving Clio's global GTM compensation and rewards strategy spanning SMB and Enterprise segments, partnering with Sales, Channel, and CS leadership to ensure alignment with company objectives, GTM motions, and growth stages.
Leading the design, modeling, and optimization of Sales and CS compensation plans, pay mix, quotas, accelerators, SPIFFs, and performance levers that drive desired behaviors, improve productivity, and support multi-year growth.
Partnering with Finance and Sales/CS Ops to model plan effectiveness, risk, and ROI, leading quarterly and annual compensation effectiveness reviews (attainment distribution, cost of sale, capacity utilization), and ensuring plans support revenue predictability, margin targets, and financial planning.
Developing and delivering clear, compelling compensation education and enablement programs for leaders, managers, and individual contributors, translating complex compensation concepts into simple, actionable narratives that build trust across GTM teams.

Compensation Administration & Systems

Ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant compensation processing in partnership with Payroll, Finance, HR, Legal, and RevOps.
Establishing and maintaining compensation governance, principles, and decision frameworks to ensure consistency, fairness, and scalability.
Owning compensation communications, including plan documentation, guidelines, timelines, and appeals processes.
Leading the refinement, governance, and continuous improvement of Clio's compensation and commission system (Forma.ai), driving automation, self-service, and operational excellence across regions.
Championing automation, self-service, and AI capabilities across planning and compensation to improve accuracy, scalability, and stakeholder experience.

Leadership & Team Development

Leading, coaching, and developing high-performing GTM planning and compensation teams, fostering accountability, strategic thinking, and continuous improvement.
Building scalable processes and operating rhythms, including the cross-functional planning calendar with Finance, HR, and GTM leadership, that enable the team to move from transactional execution to strategic impact.
Supporting change management for new plans, territories, tools, and policies across regions.
Serving as a role model for cross-functional partnership, ownership, and results-driven leadership.

What you bring:

8+ years of experience in SaaS or technology, with direct ownership of capacity planning, territory, quota, and compensation design.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior GTM and Finance leaders.
Excellent executive-level communication skills, both written and verbal.
Experience leading and developing teams, with a focus on coaching and accountability.
High integrity, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive information.
Ability to thrive in ambiguity, make high-quality decisions with incomplete data, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
Action oriented, ownership driven mindset with a strong bias toward impact and results.
Proven ability to develop presentations with strong visual storytelling.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience in translating measurements into recommendations, and connecting multiple data sources and building dashboards in data visualization tools (CRMA, Looker, Tableau, Google Sheets).
Knowledge of statistical modeling techniques.
Fluency in Salesforce data and at least one planning or ICM platform.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions to be in office minimum twice per week. (Find your Hub)
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
EAP benefits for you and household members, including counseling and online resources
401k matching and Child Education Savings
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The on-target earnings (OTE) salary range for this role is $207,400 to $311,000 reflecting base salary plus variable compensation at 100% attainment. Variable compensation is not guaranteed and will depend on individual, team, or company performance. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

new_jobs.title: Director, GTM Planning & Compensation
new_jobs.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

Revenue Operations is a strategic growth engine at Clio, accountable for optimizing how we acquire, expand, and retain revenue globally. We partner with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Customer Support to design scalable GTM systems, align incentives to company strategy, and enable predictable, durable growth. The Revenue Operations team provides executive level insights, drives cross-functional decision making, and continuously improves GTM effectiveness through data, systems, and process excellence across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

We are seeking a Director of GTM Planning and Compensation
to own and evolve Clio’s global GTM planning, territory design, and incentive compensation functions as a core lever of growth, performance, and behavior change. This role is available to candidates in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto, or remotely across Canada (excluding Québec) and the US.

This role is responsible for translating company and GTM strategy into capacity plans, territories, quotas, and incentive design that drives the right outcomes across Sales, Channel, and Customer Success. You will operate as a strategic advisor to GTM and Finance leadership, balancing competitiveness, simplicity, scalability, and financial discipline.

You will lead capacity planning, territory design and maintenance, and incentive compensation planning, governance, and administration globally, oversee compensation systems and analytics, and build a high-performing sales planning function that scales with Clio’s rapid expansion. Your work will directly influence revenue predictability, seller behavior, retention, and long-term growth.

What you’ll work on:

GTM Planning, Capacity & Quotas

Leading GTM capacity planning and quota-setting, translating growth targets into coverage, headcount, and productivity plans across Sales and CS.
Developing and evolving quota-setting methodologies, ensuring targets are grounded in market opportunity, historical performance, and productivity expectations.
Partnering with Finance and GTM leadership to model capacity needs, ramp assumptions, productivity, and hiring requirements for annual and long-range planning, including scenario models that show the tradeoffs between headcount, coverage, quotas, productivity, compensation, and revenue before decisions are made.
Establishing planning frameworks and analytics to monitor capacity, quota attainment, and productivity and inform in-year adjustments.
Owning quota exceptions, relief policies, and disputes, balancing consistency with practical business judgment.

Compensation Strategy & Plan Design

Owning and evolving Clio's global GTM compensation and rewards strategy spanning SMB and Enterprise segments, partnering with Sales, Channel, and CS leadership to ensure alignment with company objectives, GTM motions, and growth stages.
Leading the design, modeling, and optimization of Sales and CS compensation plans, pay mix, quotas, accelerators, SPIFFs, and performance levers that drive desired behaviors, improve productivity, and support multi-year growth.
Partnering with Finance and Sales/CS Ops to model plan effectiveness, risk, and ROI, leading quarterly and annual compensation effectiveness reviews (attainment distribution, cost of sale, capacity utilization), and ensuring plans support revenue predictability, margin targets, and financial planning.
Developing and delivering clear, compelling compensation education and enablement programs for leaders, managers, and individual contributors, translating complex compensation concepts into simple, actionable narratives that build trust across GTM teams.

Compensation Administration & Systems

Ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant compensation processing in partnership with Payroll, Finance, HR, Legal, and RevOps.
Establishing and maintaining compensation governance, principles, and decision frameworks to ensure consistency, fairness, and scalability.
Owning compensation communications, including plan documentation, guidelines, timelines, and appeals processes.
Leading the refinement, governance, and continuous improvement of Clio's compensation and commission system (Forma.ai), driving automation, self-service, and operational excellence across regions.
Championing automation, self-service, and AI capabilities across planning and compensation to improve accuracy, scalability, and stakeholder experience.

Leadership & Team Development

Leading, coaching, and developing high-performing GTM planning and compensation teams, fostering accountability, strategic thinking, and continuous improvement.
Building scalable processes and operating rhythms, including the cross-functional planning calendar with Finance, HR, and GTM leadership, that enable the team to move from transactional execution to strategic impact.
Supporting change management for new plans, territories, tools, and policies across regions.
Serving as a role model for cross-functional partnership, ownership, and results-driven leadership.

What you bring:

8+ years of experience in SaaS or technology, with direct ownership of capacity planning, territory, quota, and compensation design.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior GTM and Finance leaders.
Excellent executive-level communication skills, both written and verbal.
Experience leading and developing teams, with a focus on coaching and accountability.
High integrity, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive information.
Ability to thrive in ambiguity, make high-quality decisions with incomplete data, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
Action oriented, ownership driven mindset with a strong bias toward impact and results.
Proven ability to develop presentations with strong visual storytelling.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience in translating measurements into recommendations, and connecting multiple data sources and building dashboards in data visualization tools (CRMA, Looker, Tableau, Google Sheets).
Knowledge of statistical modeling techniques.
Fluency in Salesforce data and at least one planning or ICM platform.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions to be in office minimum twice per week. (Find your Hub)
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
EAP benefits for you and household members, including counseling and online resources
401k matching and Child Education Savings
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The on-target earnings (OTE) salary range for this role is $207,400 to $311,000 reflecting base salary plus variable compensation at 100% attainment. Variable compensation is not guaranteed and will depend on individual, team, or company performance. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.
